document.about: IBF BOPP film technical data sheet, made from Word (1 page). Its units column and its test conditions set the degree sign as a raised `o`: `°C` alone in a cell, and `(130°C, 1 bar, 1s)` after a number.

notes: 2026-11-24 (#136): a degree set as a raised `o` read as the letter at the head of a units cell (`oC`), where nothing comes before it to measure it against.

checks.issue: The Sealing temperature units cell read `oC`.
The test condition's degree after its number is read already, and stays.
